"Create a fully playable 3D adventure action game with stunning graphics, immersive environments, and smooth gameplay.

Game features:

1. Open-world environment with forests, mountains, rivers, villages, and mysterious locations.
2. A customizable main character with realistic animations.
3. Combat system with swords, guns, special abilities, and powerful enemies.
4. Multiple missions, quests, boss battles, and hidden treasures.
5. Intelligent enemies with different attack patterns.
6. Beautiful 3D graphics, realistic lighting, shadows, and weather effects.
7. Background music and immersive sound effects.
8. A user-friendly interface with health bars, inventory, maps, and quest tracking.
9. Smooth character movement, running, jumping, dodging, and attacking.
10. Save and load game progress.

Make the game fun, challenging, visually impressive, and fully playable. Include all necessary game mechanics and ensure there are no broken buttons or unfinished features.

Optimize the game for both PC and Android mobile devices.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, visually polished, playable 3D-style adventure action game optimized for desktop and mobile.

## Requirements
- Open world with forests, mountains, rivers, villages, and a mysterious shrine.
- Customizable main character; playable combat, movement, quests, bosses, enemies, treasure, inventory, map, save/load, sound, and mobile controls.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a self-contained browser game using HTML canvas and JavaScript.
- Used stylized 2D/canvas-rendered 3D presentation rather than external game assets or dependencies.
- Assumed PC keyboard and touch controls as the primary input methods.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the full game interface and start screen.
- Added procedural open world, terrain, river, roads, landmarks, trees, rocks, flowers, and weather.
- Added player movement, jumping is not implemented, sword combat, Ember bolt ability, dodge, stamina, health, XP, and potions.
- Added enemy AI, boss encounter, combat patterns, projectiles, loot, particles, and respawning.
- Added main quest chain, sunshards, shrine objective, inventory, minimap, large map, quest tracking, and local save/load.
- Added mobile touch controls and responsive UI.
- Added ambient synth audio toggle.
- Validated JavaScript syntax and browser loading.
- Captured desktop title and gameplay screenshots.

### Active
- Final visual/world rendering adjustments.
- Screenshot validation of the active gameplay scene.

### Blocked
- Automated browser setup could not use the configured Playwright CLI launch options because the CLI expects a separately installed Chromium build.
- Browser validation was completed using the system Chrome channel instead.

## Next Move
1. Confirm the latest gameplay screenshot after the final ground/river rendering adjustment.
2. Test movement, combat, interaction, inventory, map, pause, and save/load in-browser.
3. Test the responsive mobile layout and touch controls.
4. Add a favicon to eliminate the remaining 404 console message if desired.

## Relevant Files
- `[index.html]`: Complete game implementation, UI, rendering, gameplay systems, and responsive controls.

## Important Context
- The game is served at `http://localhost:3002` by a temporary Python server.
- Screenshot files were saved at `/tmp/opencode/wildbound.jpg` and `/tmp/opencode/wildbound-game.jpg`.
- The browser console currently reports only a missing `/favicon.ico` 404.
